text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A new wind blows! Both an auspicious
updraft and
a whirling wind, lifting me
up...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like a budding plant breaking through
the
surface of the earth, I feel a mighty
power
pushing out from within...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is the true wind of the Three
Goddesses.
Hehe. I shall surrender
myself to it, and let it carry
me forward.
